DIAGNOSIS READY: Gouty Arthritis (Acute Monoarticular Gout)

The synovial fluid analysis showing 26,000 WBCs with 75% neutrophils confirms an inflammatory process, and the history of a prior self-resolving ankle attack is classic for gout. Although the Gram stain is negative, the clinical picture strongly favors crystal arthropathy over septic arthritis.
